run_spm_decode_pieces: run the spm_decode script to decode sentencepiece tokens from a file using a SentencePiece model
run_spm_decode_ids: run the spm_decode script to decode sentencepiece token IDs from a file using a SentencePiece model
run_spm_decode_unk_handling: run the spm_decode script to decode token IDs while remapping <<unk>> tokens to ID 0
review_main: review the main function that parses args and decodes sentencepiece tokens or IDs line by line
review_tok2int: review the tok2int helper function that remaps <<unk>> tokens to integer 0 for sentencepiece decoding
